name: shepherdr-fallow
description: Pinned Fallow for report-only maintainability checks. See docs/fallow.md.

scripts.baselines: cd ../.. && sh -c 'for c in dead-code health dupes; do fallow $c --save-baseline fallow-baselines/$c.json --quiet > /dev/null; s=$?; [ $s -lt 2 ] || exit $s; echo "saved fallow-baselines/$c.json"; done'
